decisions.reason: After a full year on the market, this cleaning soap remains tightly linked to the firm's installed base and service know-how, so the firm can readily learn from customer use and keep improving rather than withdraw it.

The maintenance oil line builds directly on the firm's knowledge of wood surface treatment and aftercare, and its multiple variants give enough scope for incremental adjustment through in-house R&D and installer feedback.

This care product range is closely related to the firm's oiled-floor expertise, so absorptive capacity is strong, although some overlap with nearby care products still leaves a modest rationalisation risk.

A moisture-protection underlay fits the firm's system-selling approach in flooring and can be supported by existing technical guidance and channel relationships, making continuation the more likely choice.

The high-density underlay foam is adjacent to core flooring competences and benefits from the firm's accessory knowledge, but as a more standardised add-on it still carries the highest risk of being pruned if margins or uptake disappoint.

The oak parquet line is very close to the firm's core wood-processing, design, and flooring capabilities, so learning, adaptation, and commercial application are all strong and withdrawal is unlikely.
